answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Seconded train driver licence with rail safety attestation flips the bet — a licence safety officers renew after assessed runs — and the pulse lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the umber of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The ember is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
